about: The Wayfarer's classes and skill trees (docs/design/skill-trees.md): 3 branches x 3 tiers per class. A skill needs the one above it in its branch. 'effect' names what the game does with it (src/skills.c); skills without one can be learned but do nothing yet, and say so.

classes.name: IRONCLAD
classes.about: Armored shock trooper who holds the line and outlasts the fight.

skills.name: Plated Mesh
skills.text: Max health +15.

skills.name: Capacitor Surge
skills.text: Shields start recharging half a second sooner.

skills.name: Juggernaut
skills.text: A breaking shield knocks enemies back and clears bullets.

skills.name: Hair-Pin Draw
skills.text: Reloads take half the time.

skills.name: Heavy Rifling
skills.text: Shots fly a quarter faster.

skills.name: Breach and Clear
skills.text: A magazine's last round deals double damage.

skills.name: Expanded Drums
skills.text: Every magazine holds 2 more rounds.

skills.name: Penetrators
skills.text: Shots pierce through one enemy.

skills.name: Resupply
skills.text: Elites drop a crate: shield and full ammo.

classes.name: VOLT-WEAVER
classes.about: Bends lightning to their will: shocks, warps and fields.

skills.name: Galvanic
skills.text: Moving builds static: the next hit shocks for +2.

skills.name: Chain Arc
skills.text: Shots arc to a second enemy for half damage.

skills.name: Tesla Storm
skills.text: Swings release three seeking sparks.

skills.name: Blink Dash
skills.text: Dashes go further and protect you longer.

skills.name: Decoy
skills.text: Dashing leaves an afterimage enemies shoot at.

skills.name: Fracture
skills.text: Dash again mid-jump to warp ahead, shocking enemies.

skills.name: Flux Siphon
skills.text: Bullets that hit you restore a point of shield.

skills.name: Reflect
skills.text: Your blade sends bullets back twice as fast.

skills.name: Superconductor
skills.text: Below a quarter health, a pulse freezes enemies.

classes.name: BALLISTICIAN
classes.about: Frontline gunner: more lead, more pellets, never slowing down.

skills.name: Rapid Cycle
skills.text: Every gun fires a little faster.

skills.name: Cluster Shot
skills.text: Shotguns fire one more pellet.

skills.name: Shrapnel
skills.text: Critical hits burst into three flechettes.

skills.name: Bandolier
skills.text: Half again as much reserve ammo.

skills.name: Thermite
skills.text: Shots set enemies burning.

skills.name: Sentry Pod
skills.text: SELECT+A drops a turret that fires on its own.

skills.name: Tactical Roll
skills.text: A burst of speed after every dash.

skills.name: Momentum
skills.text: Firing never slows you down.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.text: Three kills in two seconds: endless ammo for three.

classes.name: GHOST-STALKER
classes.about: Covert ranger: long sight, a sharp blade, hard to pin down.

skills.name: Hawk Sight
skills.text: Auto-aim reaches 32 pixels further.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.text: The first hit on a healthy enemy deals double.

skills.name: Fatal Horizon
skills.text: Sniping a weak enemy kills it outright.

skills.name: Sweeping Edge
skills.text: Your blade sweeps a wider arc.

skills.name: Parry
skills.text: Hitting an enemy as it winds up stuns it.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.text: A three-hit combo ends in a full spin.

skills.name: Sixth Sense
skills.text: Enemies off screen show at the HUD's edge.

skills.name: Mirage
skills.text: Kills hide you from enemy aim for a second.

skills.name: Shadow
skills.text: Dashing leaves a decoy that copies your next shot.
